messages.body: worker_status: succeeded; reflect verdict: refactor (advisory). /sc:workflow (invoked through the Skill tool) wrote the plan at .dev/tasks/to-do/TASK-WF-spec-20261108-181640/TASK-WF-spec-20261108-181640.md: 12 tasks in 4 phases, each with acceptance criteria. It covers SPEC sections 3-4 plus the INSTALL.md task (Task 11) and the S1 brief templates task (Task 12, built from T05-T10), applies both owner rulings (no Unattended section in the variant; review-3 brief text verbatim), and .dev/tasks is staged. The gate passed; the Tier-2 reflect (2 reviewers plus an adversarial merge, 0 citations dropped) found 3 HIGH defects the plan should fix before /sc:implement: QA-001, review 1 can defer every critical finding and PASS falsely; INV-001, replay re-reads a report the command has already appended to and may exit 6, voiding replicates; INV-010, proxy_all ignores review-2 deferrals and withdrawals, which needs an owner ruling (source.md:280) together with INV-029 on early-PASS scoring. Not covered: progress.md is not created, because /sc:implement creates it on its first run (workflow protocol); per the protocol reflect findings did not edit the plan; the SPEC defines no change for the T10 R3 reviser brief, so that is left to the coordinator. Full reflect report: .dev/brainstorms/346-diffgate/workflow-report/nested/reflect-1/REPORT.md.
